verdict.rationale: Anytype publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI document at developers.anytype.io/openapi-v2.yaml, with full component schemas and documented error responses, synced from the core repo on releases. The API reference behind it is versioned with dated releases. The probe 404s were on the separate doc.anytype.io domain, so they do not contradict the developer-portal spec. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec download, and explicit evidence that the stable v1 spec (not just the pre-release v2) is downloadable.
